profile.entities: Raymond Realty Limited (Parent); No material subsidiaries disclosed
profile.subseg: Premium Residential (TenX, Address by GS, Invictus); Retail Development; Joint Development Agreements (JDA)
profile.themes: Asset-light JDA scaling; Thane legacy land monetization; Margin expansion via project maturity; Consolidation in MMR

deepdive.sec: Branded Residential Real Estate / MMR Redevelopment

bull_bear.body: Strict debt discipline (max 1:1 D/E, currently 0.6x). Internal accruals (INR 600-650 cr/year from Thane + early JDA cash) reinvested into approval costs for new pipeline. No dividend commentary; focus on balance sheet growth and funding organic pipeline.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Execution risk on JDA timelines (partner dependencies can delay launches from 9 months to 2.5 years). Intense competition in Thane capping price realization. Prolonged construction cost inflation. Regulatory/approval delays in MMR. Negative operating cash flows during expansion phase.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and validated; emphasizes 'discipline' in deal-making despite market overheating. Transparent on margin mechanics (blended vs. project-level) and cash flow dynamics. Patient on valuation rerating, expecting consistency over 6-8 quarters to build institutional faith.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Achieved 50:50 legacy-vs-JDA booking mix one year ahead of 2027 target. Thane sales volume is structurally capped by micro-market saturation rather than company-specific issues, making JDA expansion critical for >20% growth. Revenue recognition follows percentage-of-completion, smoothing lumpiness seen in peers using completed-contract method.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- The capital profile slide states an Avg. ROE of 24% and an FY26 Debt/Equity of 0.6, captioned "Profitable growth delivered with financial discipline."
- Growth is asset-light on the second engine — expansion into MMR is via JDAs rather than land purchase, with the first JDA signed in 2023 and ₹27,000 Cr of JDA GDV assembled since.
- The deck gives no dividend policy, buyback, payout ratio or land-acquisition budget.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Thane (Legacy Land): ~45% of operations; stable pre-sales INR 1,300-1,500 cr/year; intense competition limits pricing power. JDA/MMR Expansion: ~55% of operations; high-growth engine penetrating Bandra, BKC, Wadala, Sion, Kandivali. Retail: Small but consistent value-accretive component (e.g., Park Street).
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply chain disruption in ceramics (Morbi gas constraints) potentially raising input costs for construction. | Raymond Realty Limited | beneficiary | High | Management confirmed contracted rates with suppliers remain intact; any cost escalation (3-4%) is fully pass-through to customers, protecting margins while competitors without pricing power may suffer. |
| Intense competition and price stagnation in Thane micro-market limiting volume/price growth for pure-play Thane developers. | Unlisted/Smaller Thane-focused Developers | loser | Med | Raymond's diversification into high-margin MMR JDAs (54% of bookings) offsets Thane stagnation, whereas peers concentrated solely in Thane face structural growth ceilings. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- "With a 100-year umbrella brand legacy, Raymond Realty has rapidly evolved from one location to a full scale Real Estate business" — foray into real estate framed from 1925, maiden project TenX Habitat in Thane launched 2019.
- Twin Engine GDV structure: Engine 1 (own land) ₹25,000 Cr and Engine 2 (JDAs) ₹27,000 Cr, for a deck-stated total of ₹52,000 Cr.
- Own-land engine is Thane-centric ("scaled across multiple projects worth ₹ 25,000 Cr GDV in Thane"); JDA engine began with the first JDA in 2023 — The Address by GS, Bandra — and has "scaled across multiple JDA projects worth ₹27,000 Cr GDV in MMR".
- Execution credential claimed: 2022 "Accomplished a first in kind real estate milestone by delivering 3 towers, two years ahead of RERA timelines."
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] 2025: "Demerged into an Independent Listed Entity" — Raymond Realty Limited, CIN L41000MH2019PLC332934, ISIN INE1SY401010, NSE symbol RAYMONDREL / BSE scrip 544420, registered office Jekegram, Pokhran Road No.1, Thane (W).
- [Naming] The covering letter signs off "For Raymond Realty Limited (formerly known as Raymond Lifestyle Limited)" — the deck offers no further explanation of the name change.
- [Leadership] Chairman Gautam Hari Singhania (has led Raymond for over 35 years); Managing Director Harmohan Sahni, a Chartered Accountant with over 30 years in real estate and core sectors; CFO Ankur Jindal, a Chartered Accountant with over 24 years' experience.
- [Booking reversal] Invictus by GS (BKC) shows negative Q1FY27 activity — No of Bookings (1) and Value of Bookings -6 Cr — implying a cancellation, which the deck does not comment on.
- [Disclaimer] The deck states the information "has not been subjected to review by Auditors or the Board of Directors of the Company" and that prior-period figures have been regrouped/reclassified.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Blended EBITDA margin guided at 16-18% for FY27. New launches start with single-digit margins, maturing to ~20%+; portfolio mix drives blended rate. Construction cost inflation (war/commodity) estimated at 3-4% impact if prolonged, but fully pass-through expected; no margin erosion anticipated. Ceramic supply disruptions (Morbi) deemed non-material.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: >20% YoY (minimum guidance). EBITDA Margin: 16-18% (blended) for FY27. Order Inflow: Targeting consistent >20% growth in pre-sales. Capex/Commissioning: High approval costs for new JDAs to continue; Operating Cash Flow expected to remain negative for next 2 years due to reinvestment in growth pipeline.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Total GDV Pipeline: ~INR 42,000 cr. Thane Legacy Land: ~INR 25,000 cr potential (60 acres under development). JDA Pipeline: 7 projects, ~INR 17,000 cr potential (includes Kandivali, Wadala, Sion, Bandra). Recent Launches (Q4): Address by GS (Wadala & Sion) combined GDV INR 6,400 cr; TenX District 9 & Park Street (Thane). Upcoming: Two Mahim projects (launch by Q3 FY27), Kandivali (spillover to FY28).
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Two Mahim projects (advanced approval stage) launching in FY27; Kandivali project ramping up; Potential activation of commercial development in Thane (master-planned, timing TBD); Pipeline of negotiated deals spilling into FY27 despite selective discipline in overheated segments.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Raymond Realty validated its asset-light pivot with FY26 revenue up 29% and a strategic shift to 54% JDA-driven bookings (vs 22% in FY25), achieving the 50:50 mix target a year early. While FY27 operating cash flows remain negative due to approval capex for new launches, the company guides for 16-18% EBITDA margins and >20% top-line growth, leveraging a INR 42,000 crore GDV pipeline.
